title: European Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform
excerpt: The platform provides up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees to support renewable energy and clean technology projects across the Mediterranean.
bodyHtml:
The European Commission announced the launch of the T-MED Investment Platform on October 26, 2026. The platform is a component of the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean Tech Cooperation Initiative, which is a flagship initiative of the Pact for the Mediterranean.

The initiative offers up to €4.5 billion in guarantee capacity under the European Fund for Sustainable Development Plus. These guarantees are intended to reduce investment risks and attract private capital for projects including renewable electricity generation, renewable hydrogen, electricity transmission and distribution networks, energy storage, cross-border interconnections and clean technology manufacturing.

The platform will also support efforts to improve regulatory frameworks, permitting procedures, grid access and power purchase agreements, while promoting skills development and local clean technology value chains. By 2035, T-MED aims to mobilise up to €25 billion in expected investments in renewable energy production, electricity grids, interconnections and clean technologies, alongside the training and upskilling of up to 10 000 workers.
